title: Woman Horseback Riding, Country Dirt Trail - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid mid-century snapshot showing a young woman riding a dark horse down a sandy dirt path lined by a wire fence and pine trees. Captured from behind, she wears a short-sleeved blouse and rolled trousers, enjoying a quiet trail ride in the countryside. The reverse side features black paper remnants from having once been affixed into a scrap album.
